svg.title: South Australian investigation: surrounding model source vectors
svg.desc: GOFS 3.0 HYCOM+NCODA 100 m daily source vectors for fixed 2012 days 1, 183 and 366, and all-date paired availability. Common speed scale; direction glyphs every fourth cell. Gray is missing paired source data, not a coastline. Dashed line is the original 132 E section. Named-current association and physical width remain unresolved. Numerical source masks, coordinates and availability are retained in source-vectors.npz and quality.json.
